scope: Previously inventoried 101 JSON runtime files only; initial safe reviews plus safety-reviewed unique historical scripts, four exact old-core source snapshots, and referenced probe/sample evidence. No broader build/native audit.

safety.nonemptyCredentialAssignmentCheck: Copied source/text checked for nonempty quoted credential assignments and embedded secret formats; copied JSON recursively checked for nonempty sensitive field names. Monitor token variables are lifecycle values; old Home token is an authentication-state reference, not a literal. Initial review retains only two manually checked truncated documentation placeholders.
safety.privateKeyAndKnownTokenCheck: No private-key marker, recognized token, credential-bearing URI, or long encoded literal found in newly copied source/fixtures. No local source was executed.
safety.limitations: Pattern screening and manual review are not an absolute secret-safety guarantee. Existing tracked duplicates were deduplicated, not newly approved for publication. Original machine paths, source imports, historical statuses and failures remain unchanged. Probe review linkage is directory/case-level unless an exact hash relationship is specified.
safety.uiPolicy: Actual UI png/full-005.json and dynamic sessions remain excluded. ui_probe.py is archived as source text only; its output is not copied.
safety.bytePreservation: All added source and fixture filenames append .txt without changing bytes. Main agent will own a local-preserved/.gitattributes rule * -text; this agent did not create or modify that file.
